paper_metadata.title: Integration of parameterized quantum circuits within classical neural network for financial time-series prediction

summary: The paper studies a hybrid classical-quantum neural network for American Express default prediction on 5,531,451 records from 458,913 customers, using a parameterized quantum circuit with 5–8 qubits and 1–3 layers. Reported test accuracy is consistently 0.88 across the main experiments, while the best training-time result is the HNN at 453.3 s versus 3884.2–4991.3 s for CatBoost/LightGBM/XGBoost; the lowest loss reported is 0.21304 with RMSprop.
